EN:
Now here's a new face.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Are you
from another town?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Well, THIS town is the best.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's like
a dream come true.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Have fun
visiting,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
Tiens, une nouvelle tête.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Tu viens
d'une autre ville ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ici, c'est génial, tu sais.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} On ne peut
pas rêver mieux.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Alors bonne visite
à toi,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
DE:
Huch! Ein neues Gesicht...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Kommst
du aus einer anderen Stadt?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Egal, meine Stadt ist sowieso die
beste.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Traumhaft, sozusagen!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Viel Spaß noch,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}You must be a new visitor!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Well, I'd
love to show you the sights,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but {{TAG:0003:0019:}}I'm
feeling strangely groggy today.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I sure hope you have fun visiting,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu visites le coin sans doute ?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
Désolée de ne pas pouvoir te faire
visiter, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}mais je me sens bizarre, là.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}En tout cas, je te souhaite une
bonne exploration,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yeni bir ziyaretçi olmalısın!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Sana etrafı
gezdirmeyi çok isterdim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ama {{TAG:0003:0019:}}bugün tuhaf bir
şekilde uykum var.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Umarım ziyaretinde çok eğlenirsin,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Y quién eres tú?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¿U{{TAG:000E:0006:02006E0004006E006100}} turista?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¡Estás en {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} el pueblo
de tus sueños!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}} Explora tanto como
quieras, hasta que no puedas más.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Huch! Wen haben wir denn hier?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Besuch?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Nun, lieber Besucher, wir sind hier
in {{TAG:0005:0005:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} der Stadt deiner
Träume!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}} Sieh dich ruhig um!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}This is our first time meeting, isn't
it?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} I hope you have lots of fun
visiting {{TAG:0005:0005:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Hola! Siempre es un placer conocer
a gente nueva.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Diviértete por
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}È la prima volta che ci vediamo,
giusto?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Vedrai che ti divertirai qui
{{TAG:000E:0010:}} {{TAG:0005:0005:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}İlk kez tanışıyoruz, değil mi?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Umarım
{{TAG:0005:0005:}} ziyaretinde çok eğlenirsin,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
I was wondering why I didn't
recognize you. {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}It's because you're
from a different town!
Speaking of which,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} my horoscope{{TAG:0003:0003:}}
said I would meet a new friend
today!
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Maybe that's you,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
Ya decía yo que no te había
visto por aquí.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Eres de otro pueblo!
Qué curioso,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} mi horóscopo{{TAG:0003:0003:}} decía
que hoy conocería a alguien.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Debes de ser tú,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
Pas étonnant que je ne t'aie pas
reconnu{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}En fait, tu viens d'une
autre ville, pas vrai ?
Ça me fait penser...{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} Mon horoscope
avait bien prédit {{TAG:0003:0003:}}que je ferais une
nouvelle rencontre !
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}J'imagine que c'est de toi qu'il
voulait parler, alors,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
Mi chiedevo perché non riuscissi
a riconoscerti... {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sarà perché non
sei di queste parti?
A proposito,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} il mio oroscopo
diceva che {{TAG:0003:0003:}}oggi avrei fatto nuovi
incontri... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Incredibile, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
Ich hab mich schon gefragt, warum
ich dich nicht kenne.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Du bist gar
nicht von hier!
Apropos,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}} in meinem Horoskop
stand, dass ich heute jemanden
kennenlernen würde.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Das bist dann wohl du,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

Seni neden tanımadığımı merak ediyordum. {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
Meğer başka bir kasabadanmışsın!
